हेल् {c1c} A. (हेलते) To disregard;
see हेड्.

हेलनं --ना
1 Disregarding,
slighting, contempt, insulting.
--2
Sporting amorously, wanton dalliance.

हेलनं --ना
1 Disregarding,
slighting, contempt, insulting.
--2
Sporting amorously, wanton dalliance.

हेला [हेड्-भावे-डस्य लः]
1 Contempt,
disrespect, insult; Śi. 12. 72.
--2 (a)
Amorous sport or dalliance, wanton
sport; S.

.
--3 Strong sexual desire;
प्रौढेच्छयाऽतिरूढानां नारीणां सुरतोत्सवे ।
शृंगारशास्त्रतत्वज्ञैर्हेला सा परिकीर्तिता ॥
--4 Ease, facility; Śi. 1. 34; हेलया
‘easily’, without any difficulty
or trouble.
--5 Moonlight.
--6 A
pause in a note or shaking (as in
music).

हेलिः [हिल्-इन्] The sun. --f.
Wanton or amorous sport, dalliance.
